column1: # Single source of truth for non-Claude model routing. Tab-separated.
# model-usage.md/model-selection.md point here; don't let the markdown grow
# gpt-6-astra: OpenAI's frontier tier (Codex catalog default effort is LOW —
# the 4th column pins it to high; override per-call with MODEL_RUN_EFFORT).
# grok: 4.7 is the default grok (task recency -> grok-4.7-high); note its ids
# have NO "cursor-" prefix in the Cursor catalog, unlike 4.6/4.5. The 4.6 and
# 4.5 rows stay routable as legacy while the Cursor catalog still lists them.
# bin/catalog-drift.sh (routecheck + SessionStart hook) warns when a newer
# cursor-grok-* / composer-* / glm-* / gpt-* version appears in a catalog.
# second-review moved sol -> astra 2026-09-18 (half Sol's hallucination rate,
# higher AA index, no METR eval-gaming finding); gpt-5.6-sol still routable by id.
# fable-fallback: what a Fable subagent's work reroutes to when Fable is out of
# quota (see model-selection.md) — never a silent downgrade to a weaker Claude.
